scope: Direct Gemini SDK component benchmark. Excludes browser, Next.js, HTTP route, Firestore, full session, PDF OCR, repair calls, concurrent load, and learning outcomes.

pricing.formula: (promptTokenCount - cachedContentTokenCount) × $0.30/M + cachedContentTokenCount × $0.03/M + (candidatesTokenCount + thoughtsTokenCount) × $2.50/M. No cache storage charges assumed because no explicit cache was created.
pricing.derivedCostRecalculation: Derived USD values recomputed after completion to include cache hits in calls 7 and 9. Raw SDK usage metadata and model responses are unchanged.

methodology: Three repetitions per workload with identical synthetic English fixtures and production prompts/schema/settings. One request at a time, 20s minimum after completion. No retry or warmup. Stop on quota/auth errors. Latency includes request serialization, network and complete SDK response, excludes validation and pacing. Nearest-rank p50, min/max and descriptive paced throughput, no capacity claim. Correctness checks are narrow fixture checks, not general AI accuracy.
